embed.title: 🌸 Portfolio
embed.description:
Welcome to the **SouCampus Builds portfolio**, a showcase of projects we've built for servers, creators and communities.

## 🏯 What you'll find here
> 🏰 **Spawns & lobbies:** the first thing your players see
> 🌋 **Maps & landscapes:** terrain, biomes, custom worlds
> 🏛️ **Structures:** temples, castles, cities, statues
> 🎨 **Detailed pieces:** organics, interiors, decorations

Every build here was made **to order**: from a client's idea to a finished world.

## ✨ Like what you see?
Get something like this made for your server: open a ticket in <#1232357370630508675> and click **Order**.
💸 Your **first order** placed through a ticket gets **5% off**.
🤝 Bring **5 friends** who join and stay, confirm it in support: **15% off** your order. Both discounts stack.

🌐 Full gallery coming soon at **[soucampus.online](https://soucampus.online)**

embed.title: 🌿 Premade Builds
embed.description:
**Ready-made builds, available right now.** No waiting, no brief: pick one, buy it, and drop it into your world.

## 📦 How it works
> **1.** Browse the builds posted in this channel
> **2.** Found one you like? Open a ticket in <#1232357370630508675>
> **3.** Tell us which build you want (a link to the post is enough)
> **4.** Pay and get the schematic / world download ✨

## 🔍 Every post includes
> 📐 Size  ·  🧱 Minecraft version  ·  💶 Price

## 🛠️ Want it changed?
Need a different size, colours or style? We can **customize any premade build**. Just say so in your ticket.

## ⭐ Bought one?
Leave a review on its page at **[soucampus.online](https://soucampus.online/marketplace)**. We'd love to hear how it works on your server!

*Premade builds are sold for use on your server. Reselling or redistributing them isn't allowed.*

embed.title: 💎 Free Builds
embed.description:
**Free builds from SouCampus, for everyone.** 🎁

From time to time we share smaller builds completely free: a thank-you to the community and a taste of what we do.

## 📥 How to get them
> Just download from the post. No ticket, no payment needed.

## 📜 Rules for free builds
> ✅ Use them on your own server or in your world
> ✅ Edit and adapt them however you like
> ❌ Don't resell them or claim them as your own
> 💬 Credit **SouCampus Builds** if you show them off. We'd love to see it!

## 🔔 Don't miss a drop
Free builds are posted here first. Keep notifications on for this channel 👀

## ⭐ Tell us what you think
Tried a free build? Leave a review on its page at **[soucampus.online](https://soucampus.online/marketplace)**. It really helps us! 💙

Want something bigger and made just for you? Open a ticket in <#1232357370630508675>.
